summary: Listed as Muscogee Lookout Tower (gfc-310) in Muscogee County on a statewide Georgia tower list; no source found describes its history or the site today.

evidence.supports: Listed as Muscogee Lookout Tower in Muscogee County, with coordinates
The list gives the code gfc-310
gfc-nnn numbers come from an older GFC list that described 203 towers
evidence.quote: an older GFC list described the locations of 203 towers (gfc-nnn).

evidence.supports: GFC is the Georgia Forestry Commission
Names for towers 73 and above are the compiler's creation; this tower is numbered 72
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: The list page carries a revision stamp of 22 March 2016

corrections.why: The list gives the code as gfc-310 with no US prefix, and says gfc-nnn numbers come from an older GFC list.

sources.title: Georgia lookout towers (GA tower list with coordinates, elevation and GFC number)

notes_for_editor: Only one source has anything on this tower: the Georgia tower list (tnlandforms.us), which gives its coordinates, county and gfc-310 code. Two searches and several register and lookout-site pages found no history. It is not on the NHLR Georgia list (29 registered lookouts) or the FFLOS Georgia former-sites list (2 entries), so the NHLR-style registration is not supported. Brief elevation_m 192.6 assumes the list's 632 is feet; the page prints no unit, so the story omits elevation. Status and access stay unknown; the story says no source describes the site today.
